1. **Choose a selectable path of miniature scenes, displayed in one shared viewing area. Confidence: high on navigation; medium on visual appeal until prototyped.**

   Keep the winding path as an overview of Lorenzo’s history. Every step is directly selectable, with a place, dates and a short work label. Selecting one assembles its miniature in a fixed frame. The visitor can jump from Lille to Turin immediately.

   | Model | My assessment |
   |---|---|
   | Continuous world with a travelling camera | Good for a short film; unnecessarily makes navigation part of the viewing time. |
   | Selectable tapes or objects | Good direct access, but literal VHS tapes introduce another borrowed identity. |
   | Selectable path + shared scene frame | Best fit: preserves the relationships between places while allowing independent viewing. |

   Borrow Felix’s **selection model**, not his tapes. Borrow the reference video’s **assembly and visual continuity**, not its compulsory journey. No avatar, driving, dice or automatic tour in the first version.

   **Evidence:** The repository’s Felix inspection records independently selectable work and accessible HTML controls ([proposal:158](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:158)). The existing loop needs special rules explaining why the first lap passes Lille before Lille happened ([proposal:1112](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:1112)). That complication comes from the board, not Lorenzo’s biography.

   **What would change my mind:** A comparable travelling-camera prototype that improves understanding of the two returns without slowing direct access or making visitors uncomfortable.

2. **Make selecting a step immediately useful; let the build animation accompany the information. Confidence: medium-high.**

   Proposed interaction, with timings treated as prototype targets:

   - **Before selection:** Real HTML presents name, role, Complaion, technical substance, Work, Writing, CV and Email. The path has stills rendered from the 3D scenes. Nothing loads a 3D runtime yet.
   - **Select “Lille · GSK · 2023–24”:** Its heading, role, dates and result appear immediately alongside the poster. A clearly labelled **“Play scene”** action provides the initial 3D opt-in.
   - **After opt-in:** Selecting another step directly plays that scene. Keep the selector available throughout. Loading remains cancellable; text and links work while assets load.
   - **Build, approximately 2–3 seconds:** The courtyard pieces assemble, the Chamber of Commerce belfry rises, and stylised pipes connect. The camera stays fixed. Reduced motion shows the assembled state immediately.
   - **Explanation, approximately 10–15 seconds if narrated:** Suggested factual script: “At GSK in Saint-Amand-les-Eaux, I worked with plant sensor data on anomaly detection and forecasting. I designed water rejection strategies projected to save 10,000 cubic metres a year.” The complete text is readable immediately.
   - **End:** The scene settles into a still composition. No automatic next step or looping performance. Offer Replay, another step, **Read GSK experience**, CV and Email. The result never waits for a gauge interaction to become visible.

   Keep scene state addressable. Back should restore the previous selection; closing returns focus to its trigger. Refreshing a scene link should show its text and poster without starting playback.

   **Evidence:** The script is supported by [resume-data.tsx:137](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/src/data/resume-data.tsx:137). Poster-first loading, explicit opt-in and focus restoration already exist in the proposed contract ([proposal:1185](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:1185), [proposal:1222](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:1222)). The new direction should shorten the current space → card → world → discovery sequence.

   **What would change my mind:** If people consistently skip the build, shorten it. If they cannot explain the work afterward, change the scene and copy before adding interaction.

3. **Use complete text by default, with optional recordings of Lorenzo. Avoid typewriter text and synthetic impersonation. Confidence: high on the default; medium on whether recordings justify their upkeep.**

   | Option | Position |
   |---|---|
   | Lorenzo’s recorded voice | Best optional personal contribution. Requires recording, editing and re-recording when claims change. |
   | Synthesized narration | Easier to revise, but less personal. If used, label it synthetic; do not imply Lorenzo recorded it. |
   | Typed, letter-by-letter captions | Adds waiting without adding meaning. Reject as the main reading experience. |
   | Complete text | Essential baseline: inexpensive, searchable, accessible and usable silently. |

   Use a separate **“Listen to Lorenzo”** control. Selecting a scene is permission to animate, not permission to make sound. Download recordings only when requested. Provide pause, replay, synchronized captions and a complete transcript; avoid screen-reader announcements for every animated caption change.

   A saved preference is not a guarantee that a browser will permit audible playback. Handle blocked playback with a usable Play control. Browser policies vary, as documented in [MDN’s autoplay guide](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/Media/Guides/Autoplay). Captions should include any meaningful non-speech audio, following [W3C’s caption guidance](https://www.w3.org/WAI/media/av/captions/).

   Recording something does not make its content verified. Scripts must use documented work or statements supplied by Lorenzo. Do not invent why he returned home, how a city changed him, or what customers said.

   **Evidence:** Those personal motivations and customer-discovery details are explicitly missing ([proposal:88](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:88)). Existing copy already supplies distinctive language without invented memories ([resume-data.tsx:23](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/src/data/resume-data.tsx:23)).

   **What would change my mind:** If Lorenzo dislikes recording or listeners gain no additional sense of the person, ship text alone. Voice should earn its place.

4. **Keep the chosen places and materials; remove the game rules that now obscure them. Confidence: high on simplification; medium on individual scene changes.**

   **Survive:** the Bisalta, Mole, Lake Geneva and Alps, Chamber of Commerce belfry and Vieille Bourse; painted-wood appearance; all-3D source scenes; rendered stills; open “?”; HTML first; explicit opt-in; budgets; accessible controls; source credits and a making-of.

   **Change:**

   - Replace 18 spaces and two game laps with four place groups and “?”. Cuneo has clearly dated chapters for home, the first return and current work. Show returns through dates and connecting lines, without explaining “passing” versus “landing.”
   - Keep cities as the major visual anchors; do not make four corners a binding layout rule.
   - Put company names and outcomes beside each city. Visitors should not need to know where Complaion or Roche belongs.
   - Keep the lake-summary and belfry-gauge ideas as **illustrations**. Label them as such rather than letting them resemble project footage.
   - Remove the “Basel jetty” from Lake Geneva. Give Roche its own labelled work object within the Switzerland group; the current proposal itself says Basel is on the Rhine.
   - Treat Turin’s electrical mechanism as an illustration of the field of study, not something Lorenzo built. Do not withhold the degree until a slider reaches 90°.
   - Use one data source for facts, transcript and captions. A new role should not require a new city model.
   - Keep the two ADRs, but describe the revised interaction and scene-art boundaries. Leave Blender versus code open until the prototype measures the work.

   **Drop:** dice, token hops, Chance, title deeds, Public Park as contact, compulsory orbit controls, and duplicate Field notes/germinai destinations. The “?” can be a small 3D blank piece leading directly to contact; it does not need a full world.

   **Evidence:** The current space list mixes cities, degrees, employers, projects and navigation destinations ([proposal:1086](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:1086)). The geography problem is visible in the proposal’s own Switzerland description ([proposal:1020](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:1020)). The glossary still defines the homepage as “his own Monopoly,” so it would need revision alongside the storyboard ([GLOSSARY.md:158](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/GLOSSARY.md:158)).

   **What would change my mind:** Keep an individual game gesture if testing shows it communicates something specific about Lorenzo rather than merely decorating navigation.

5. **Treat proof discoverability and truthful interpretation as the main risks—not polygon count. Confidence: high.**

   The largest failure would be a memorable miniature whose viewer cannot say what Lorenzo does. Next are misleading visual metaphors, miniature labels that fail on phones, and maintenance that requires rebuilding artwork whenever a role changes.

   The automated requirements are necessary but insufficient. I verified **46 entries** in the retained-proof manifest. Its test combines visible text from `/` and `/cv`; it does not establish that a visitor will find or understand the evidence. The fold test checks technical words and a named system, not comprehension. Neither guarantees that “projected” stays attached to the water-saving number.

   **Evidence:** [retained-proof.json:3](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/spec/retained-proof.json:3), [cv-route.spec.ts:197](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/tests/cv-route.spec.ts:197), [homepage-fold.spec.ts:73](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/tests/homepage-fold.spec.ts:73). The proposal explicitly requires the projected qualifier ([proposal:822](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:822)).

   **What would change my mind:** Visitors reliably identifying his current work, finding a relevant result and reaching contact without coaching would establish that the experience supports the professional purpose.

6. **Prototype one finished scene and a second rough selectable scene before building the complete board. Confidence: high on the experiment; medium on the thresholds below.**

   Start with **Lille**, because it tests the hardest useful combination: recognisable landmark, technical work, a qualified result and short narration. Add a rough Cuneo state to test jumping between steps and keeping current work prominent. One scene alone cannot test non-sequential navigation.

   Build only the HTML arrival, selector, shared frame, one assembly animation, still fallback and optional recording. Compare it with the same content presented as ordinary cards. Test with five people resembling the intended audience.

   Suggested decision thresholds—not statistical claims:

   - At least four find current work, CV and contact within 15 seconds without playing anything.
   - At least four jump directly to a requested step without help.
   - At least four recall one actual work contribution afterward; anyone interpreting projected savings as achieved triggers a revision.
   - The scene improves recall of the work or person over the cards. “Nice graphics” alone is insufficient.
   - Keyboard, reduced motion and no-WebGL visitors obtain the same information and actions.
   - The finished scene meets the accepted transfer budget and works on a real mid-range phone—or phones receive the complete still-based version.

   Retain the proposed limits of 1.5 MB per world, 150 KB per still and 8 MB overall, but explicitly account for the shared runtime, decoders and any recordings. Measure production and revision time too. If a short assembly is equally effective as a pre-rendered 3D clip, prefer that over a live renderer.

   **Evidence:** The existing plan already calls for one measured world and admits real-phone performance is unknown ([proposal:1272](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:1272)); budgets appear at [proposal:1326](/Volumes/Code/Personal/Lorenzo-Germini/.claude/worktrees/revamp-web/docs/research/experience-rethink.md:1326). My change is to test navigation and comprehension before committing to the full HTML loop.

   **What would change my mind:** If the scene adds little beyond the still, ship stills. If even the stills distract from proof, retain the path as a small optional feature rather than the homepage’s organising structure.

**Verdict: build a freely selectable path whose miniature scenes assemble on demand, with immediate professional evidence and optional real narration; retire the Monopoly machinery.**
